title: Clojure in a nutshell by James Trunk
summary: James Trunk introduces Clojure syntax and thinking, covering its core data structures, immutability, the thread-last macro and live data analysis in the REPL.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a clear, enjoyable introduction to Clojure and a good example of REPL-driven development.

quote.text: gave one of the most clear and enjoyable technical introductions to Clojure I've seen. Recommended!
